Peppermint Cake
By: Carrie Barr
Published: Monday, November 30, 2009 - 12:32pm

Ingredients




2 cups cake flour, sifted
1 teaspoon baking soda,
 cup shortening
1/4 cup sugar
1 egg
2 ounces baking chocolate, melted
1/2 teaspoon peppermint oil,
2 teaspoons vanilla extract,
3/4 cup milk

Preparation

1 Sift flour, baking soda and salt together. Cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg and beat well. Add chocolate, peppermint oil and vanilla and blend thoroughly. Beat in yogurt.  2 Add flour mixture and milk alternately in small amounts. Beat well after each addition. Pour batter into two well-greased 9-in. pans or one 9" X 13" pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes or until cake tests done.
